content:
**The five “General‑Field” (often called the “Big Four plus Best New Artist”) categories at the 65th Annual Grammy Awards (held 5 February 2023) and their winners**

| # | Grammy category | Winner (artist / work) | Brief note |
|---|----------------|------------------------|------------|
| 1 | **Record of the Year** | **Lizzo – “About Damn Time”** | Recognises the performing artist **and** the production team (producer, engineer, mixers, mastering). The track was taken from Lizzo’s 2022 album *Special*. |
| 2 | **Album of the Year** | **Harry Styles – *Harry’s House*** | Awards the artist, featured artists, producers, recording engineers/mixers and mastering engineers for an entire album. *Harry’s House* was released in May 2022. |
| 3 | **Song of the Year** | **Bonnie Raitt – “Just Like That”** (songwriter: Bonnie Raitt) | Honors the **songwriter(s)** only. “Just Like That” appeared on Raitt’s 2022 album *Just Like That…* and gave her her first Grammy in this category. |
| 4 | **Best New Artist** | **Samara Joy** | Recognises a breakthrough artist who released a qualifying body of work during the eligibility period. Samara Joy is a jazz vocalist whose debut album *Heart Play* (2022) propelled her to the win. |
| 5 | **Best Pop Solo Performance** *(the fifth major category presented during the televised ceremony)* | **Taylor Swift – “Anti‑Hero”** | Awards a solo vocal performance in the pop genre. “Anti‑Hero” is the lead single from Swift’s 2022 album *Midnights*. |

### Why these five?

The Grammy Awards have dozens of genre‑specific categories, but the ceremony’s **core “General Field”** consists of the four major awards (Record, Album, Song, and Best New Artist). The televised show also highlights a fifth high‑profile category—*Best Pop Solo Performance*—which is often grouped with the “big” awards in press coverage of the night. Together they represent the most widely‑publicized honors of the 65th Grammy Awards.

### Sources (Wikipedia & Grammy.com)

- *65th Annual Grammy Awards* – Wikipedia entry (lists winners for each category).  
- Official Grammy website – “Winners & Nominees” page for the 2023 ceremony (shows the same five winners).  

*(If you need a deeper dive into any of the other 80+ genre‑specific categories, just let me know!)*
